landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.q1.q: What if there's no course for my university?
landing.faq.q1.a: Post on the course request board. Teachers see requests with more votes, and you'll be notified when a course is published.
landing.faq.q2.q: How do I pay? What if money is deducted but the course doesn't open?
landing.faq.q2.a: With bKash, Nagad, Rocket or card. Our server verifies the payment with the gateway itself and re-checks automatically if anything gets stuck.
landing.faq.q3.q: What can you see when I connect Google Classroom?
landing.faq.q3.a: Only your classes, assignments, your own submission status, materials and announcements — read-only. Disconnecting deletes all cached data.
landing.faq.q4.q: Do courses guarantee what will be in the exam?
landing.faq.q4.a: No. Teachers highlight likely important topics — that's not a guarantee. Covering the full syllabus is always safest.
landing.faq.q5.a: Yes — within 48 hours of purchase if you've watched less than 20% of the course.
